answer: Put a refundable bond behind every identity and let the people who check the work keep the bond when the work turns out hollow. A farm must finance every copy up front, and each bond is lost as soon as its work is judged empty, so the entry ticket for a ridge of clones becomes prohibitive. Rewarding the catcher keeps an inlet under constant review, and an honest agent recovers its ivory untouched, so only manufactured identities lose.
